label: What CSIA Flight Assurance supports, from measured evidence only. Do not claim generic PX4 support.

product_boundary.kind: offboard analysis of PX4 ULogs (SITL, HIL, flight test, incident replay)

supported.evidence: 2.3 validation flights V1-V13; RB-001 flights; XSYS-001 (all SITL, SIH quad X)

unsupported.evidence: real FMUv5 boat log, PRIME RR-09: analysed as a quadrotor without saying so before PRIME
real CubeOrange VTOL log accepted by the profile gate (RB-001); no VTOL profile

unsupported.type: hexa-, octo-, tri- or coaxial multirotors (CA_ROTOR_COUNT != 4)
unsupported.evidence: profile r1 is a quadrotor; 2.3 SCALE.md tested the reasoning only

tested.version: PX4 1.6 to 1.14-era real and SITL logs (pyulog test corpus; a real FMUv5 boat log)

px4.propulsion_evidence_requires: control allocation (actuator_motors, control_allocator_status) and ESC telemetry with RPM (esc_status)

partial.case: PX4 before control allocation (actuator_controls_0 / actuator_outputs only), e.g. RflyMAD's real flights
partial.effect: no propulsion evidence; PX4 monitor events and battery context only
the EKF2 estimator producer is not run; stated as a coverage notice

optional.battery_status: battery context; current needed for power records (power.source_health, droop_vs_current)
optional.estimator_status: EKF2 innovation evidence and configuration epochs
optional.cpuload: not evidence (no deadline to pair it with)

logging.rule: a topic gap longer than 3 x the PX4 547e2ca default interval refuses that topic's evidence over the gap (2.3 log completeness)
logging.envelope: propulsion topics at >= 5 Hz with no gap over 300 ms keep every confirmation in the stress envelope; at an effective 300 ms interval confirmations are lost (PRIME STRESS_ENVELOPE.md)

known_margins.esc_status at 248 ms in newer PX4 defaul: inside the gap rule by 52 ms (RB-001 RR-05)
known_margins.failure_detector_status at about 500 ms: the gap rule would refuse every window; no current output reads it through the rule (PRIME)

conditions_checked_per_log.gyro_bias_note: above it the compensation is refused as NOT_STEADY_FLIGHT and real losses go unconfirmed (stress envelope; a real CubeOrange carried 0.067 rad/s)
conditions_checked_per_log.logger_dropouts: reported; windows over a dropout are refused

px4:esc.telemetry_response.role: context (no symptom reads it; finding SB-1)

needs: steady flight in both windows (body rate <= 0.0989 rad/s)

px4:battery.status.role: power context; current measured for source health

diagnosable.fault: a motor losing effectiveness in hover or a hold
diagnosable.result: COMMAND_NO_RESPONSE on the right motor, AMBIGUOUS among 4 explanations; the sensor explanation eliminated
diagnosable.evidence: SITL only: 2.3 V1-V4, V12; RB-001 EH1

diagnosable.fault: ESC telemetry corruption on a healthy motor (offline or ESC OFF/WRONG)
diagnosable.result: telemetry deficit as context; no motor symptom
diagnosable.evidence: SITL only: 2.3 V9, V10; XSYS-001 case B; PRIME B_telemetry stress base

diagnosable.result: PX4 monitor events as context; no propulsion diagnosis

partial_coverage.case: a motor losing effectiveness during continuous maneuvering
partial_coverage.result: telemetry deficit reported; physical response refused (NOT_STEADY_FLIGHT); the loss is NOT confirmed
many dismissed candidate events (about 300 per hour in SITL)

not_diagnosable: compute or timing faults (no stock topic pairs load with deadlines)
command delivery to the ESC (no stock topic shows delivery)
ESC current faults and the stall check, when esc_status carries no current
power-path faults without measured battery current
any fault on real hardware: no real propulsion validation exists yet
